items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: that's where I met the Whitman Sisters and that's where Willie Bryant was with the Whitman Sisters that time.

ctx.x: You played in New Orleans with Louie; that was the first time you ever played New Orleans.

I didn't (inaudible) We played every place--we played all over Louisiana, but I don't ever remember playing in New Orleans. We played Lake Charles, Louisiana and that's where I met the Whitman Sisters and that's where Willie Bryant was with the Whitman Sisters that time.
When you were playing in New Orleans, it was just a theatre date?
